verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an email service with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only production mailbox access via the Gmail API, IMAP and SMTP, and gives no sign of a sandbox or test mode. Narrow or read-only OAuth scopes limit access to real data but do not isolate it, so they are an adjacent control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
